title: Remote Desktops
description: Connect this machine to another desktop's FutureOS. Its conversations appear in the shared conversation list, labelled with that machine's icon; tools run on that machine.
addHint: On the other desktop, open Phone Remote Control and copy the pairing link, then paste it here.
slotWarning: Pairing here replaces that desktop's current phone pairing. It can be re-added later with a new link.
unpairConfirmDesc: This machine will no longer connect to {{name}}. Its conversations disappear from your list.
unpairPendingWarning: Removed locally. The server could not be reached to revoke it; it will be retried.
nameHint: Shown only on this machine. It is never sent to the desktop or the platform.
settingsOfflineHint: This desktop is not connected; settings cannot be read or changed right now.
settingsAutomationHint: These change how that desktop behaves, not this one.
settingAutoUpgradeSkillsHint: Keep that desktop’s skills up to date.
settingAutoTitleHint: Name a new conversation from its first message.
settingSkillRecommendHint: Let that desktop suggest a skill while you type.
settingAutoConnectHint: Whether that desktop reopens its phone remote control on launch.
settingsHostContentHint: Read-only summary here; manage them on the desktop itself.
providersHint: API keys and endpoints configured there.
iconSectionHint: Shown next to its conversations in the list.
unpairHint: The other desktop keeps all of its data; only this pairing is removed.
renameHint: The new name is saved on the remote desktop.
forkNotSaved: That reply's turn is not saved on the remote desktop yet. Reopen the conversation and try again.
